series.noteZh: 第 3 局（-2）含底层通道内部重试告警；剔除该局后为 3:0（加权 ACPL 17.7 / 35.0）。
series.noteEn: Game 3 (-2) contains internal channel retry notices; 3:0 excluding Game 3 (weighted ACPL 17.7 / 35.0).

series.noteZh: 剔除 11 步含通道重试告警的第 2 局后为 2:1（ACPL 51.7 / 55.1）；仅计零告警的第 1、3 局为 2:0（ACPL 51.2 / 67.7）。
series.noteEn: 2:1 excluding Game 2 with 11 channel retry plies (ACPL 51.7 / 55.1); 2:0 across notice-free Games 1 & 3 (ACPL 51.2 / 67.7).

exploratory.descZh: 正式切至 Astra max 四盘对称赛前的首轮 xhigh 探路单盘（Carbon 执白）。
exploratory.descEn: Initial single-game pilot with Astra at xhigh before running the symmetric max match (Carbon as White).

exploratory.descZh: 通道接入与行棋稳定性自弈单盘（85 半回合，白胜）。
exploratory.descEn: Single-game self-play diagnostic for channel stability and move quality (85 plies, White wins).

exploratory.descZh: 仅 Opus 侧开启 drop_thinking=on 删去历史加密思考块，与双方保留思考条件不等同。
exploratory.descEn: One-sided drop_thinking=on enabled for Opus while Astra retained prior session thinking.

exploratory.descZh: real 协议首次跑通验证（reason=off 不写可见理由，仅 Opus 执白单盘）。
exploratory.descEn: First real-protocol verification game with reason=off (single game, Opus as White).

exploratory.descZh: 仅给子力清单下的中国象棋自弈诊断单盘（158 半回合，黑胜）。
exploratory.descEn: Single-game Xiangqi self-play diagnostic with piece-list input only (158 plies, Black wins).

exploratory.descZh: 早期通道清洁度核验自弈单盘（104 半回合，未跑引擎复盘）。
exploratory.descEn: Early channel verification self-play game (104 plies, no post-game engine analysis).

exploratory.descZh: 仅 Opus 侧开启 drop_thinking=on 删去历史加密思考块，单步思考量与耗时升至约 3 倍。
exploratory.descEn: One-sided drop_thinking=on enabled for Opus while Astra retained prior session thinking (~3x Opus tokens/move).

exploratory.descZh: real 协议中国象棋首跑验证（reason=off 不写可见理由，仅 Opus 执红单盘）。
exploratory.descEn: First Xiangqi real-protocol verification game with reason=off (single game, Opus as Red).

chess.headlineZh: 约 Lichess Blitz 1800 / Rapid 1920（新规上限裁决回看）
chess.headlineEn: ~1800 Lichess Blitz / ~1920 Lichess Rapid (under 200-ply engine adjudication)
chess.detailZh: 对阵 Maia-1900 与 Stockfish 19 限强 1900 / 2100 / 2300 共 30 盘（随机 8 半回合开局；原始棋谱 13 胜 12 和 5 负，按 200 半回合引擎裁决回看为 13 胜 5 和 12 负、本机刻度高于 Maia-1900 约 +189 分；原满上限判和赛制下约 Blitz 1910 / Rapid 2020）。
chess.detailEn: 30 games vs Maia-1900 and strength-limited Stockfish 19 (UCI_Elo 1900 / 2100 / 2300) with 8-ply random openings (raw PGN 13W-12D-5L; 13W-5D-12L and +189 scale points above Maia-1900 under 200-ply engine adjudication, or ~1910 Blitz / ~2020 Rapid under cap-is-draw).

xiangqi.headlineZh: Fairy-Stockfish nodes=100 基准之上 +121 Elo（95% CI: +1..+236）
xiangqi.headlineEn: +121 Elo above Fairy-Stockfish nodes=100 (95% CI: +1 to +236)
xiangqi.detailZh: 对阵 Fairy-Stockfish 14.0.1 节点阶梯 nodes=30 / 100 / 300 / 1000 共 37 盘（随机 6 半回合开局，19 胜 3 和 15 负）：与 nodes=300（+82）相当或略强，明显低于 nodes=1000（+298）；因缺乏公开人类段位锚点不折算段位。
xiangqi.detailEn: 37 games vs Fairy-Stockfish 14.0.1 node ladder (nodes=30 / 100 / 300 / 1000, 6-ply random openings, 19W-3D-15L): comparable to or slightly above nodes=300 (+82) and clearly below nodes=1000 (+298); no human dan conversion due to lack of public anchors.
